memory_update.text: NNI should remain a core underfollowed candidate for the student-loan servicing and education-payments node because it has explicit LSS and ETSP segment exposure.

FLYW should be tracked as an underfollowed education-payments infrastructure candidate, especially around tuition-payment plans, past-due tuition recovery, student refunds, and international education payments.

Navient appears more like a legacy/transition or education-loan-owner exposure after outsourcing servicing; do not treat it as a current scarce servicing-infrastructure beneficiary without fresh evidence.

node: Student-loan servicing, borrower communications, and education payments infrastructure
summary: This pass expands the universe around regulated student-loan servicing, borrower communications, education-payment workflows, tuition-payment plans, and the servicing software layer. The strongest direct public-market exposure found is Nelnet, which reports both Loan Servicing and Systems and Education Technology Services and Payments segments. Maximus is a government-services contractor with direct federal-loan-servicing exposure through Aidvantage. Flywire is a payments/software infrastructure name tied to higher-education payments, payment plans, and past-due tuition recovery. Fiserv is included as a large-cap reference/hidden supplier because Maximus disclosed that transferred student-loan accounts would continue operating on a Fiserv-owned servicing platform. Navient was not included as a candidate because current evidence suggests it is more of a legacy/transition or loan-owner exposure after outsourcing servicing, rather than a scarce servicing-infrastructure beneficiary.
